model_annotations.English: The pie chart represents the distribution of data across three categories corresponding to the years 2017, 2018, and 2019. The chart is divided into three slices, with the blue slice labeled "2019" occupying approximately 46% of the chart, the orange slice labeled "2018" occupying around 33%, and the green slice labeled "2017" occupying about 21%. The percentage and corresponding numerical value for each slice are displayed inside the respective sections. The slices are arranged in a clockwise direction, with the largest slice (2019) at the top, followed by the second-largest (2018), and then the smallest (2017). No legend is present in the chart, and none of the slices are visually emphasized.
